crossRefs.note: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the…
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.
I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they…
He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands…
He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries…
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
translations.bsb: and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
translations.kjv: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
translations.asv: and be ready against the third day; for the third day Jehovah will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
